d:
The Honor Magic 8 Pro is a feature-packed flagship with powerful hardware, impressive cameras, and a massive 7100mAh battery. But after using it as my primary device for a couple of weeks, the experience has been… a bit mixed.
In this video, I walk you through what it’s actually like to live with the Magic 8 Pro — the things I really liked, the areas where it falls short, and whether it’s worth considering at its price.
What do you think of the Honor Magic 8 Pro? Let me know in the comments!
